_about: Questions about meeting_transcript.txt (a synthetic two-person meeting). An answer passes if it contains at least one keyword from EVERY group in 'expect' (case-insensitive) and none from 'forbid'. 'unanswerable' questions pass only if the model says the transcript doesn't cover it.

Who is going to confirm the caching fix timeline, and with whom?
